title: ApiNotes Documentation
description: Schema representing an API documentation portal generated by ApiNotes from an OpenAPI specification

id.description: Unique identifier for the documentation portal

name.description: Name of the API documentation portal

description.description: Description of the API being documented

specificationUrl.description: URL of the OpenAPI or Swagger specification used to generate documentation

portalUrl.description: Public URL of the generated documentation portal

languages.description: Programming languages for which code examples are generated

liveTestingEnabled.description: Whether live endpoint testing is enabled in the portal

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the documentation was generated
